images.label: 01 从容站姿·花边
images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the edit target, an existing anime dashboard background. Preserve the exact original woman: identical face, expression, copper-gold hair color, hairstyle, dress, pose, scale, position and proportions. Preserve the existing lighting and pale peach/cream palette. Do not redraw or move the person.
Add a delicate decorative botanical lace border only along the outer left, top and bottom edges where there is empty background. Use fine ivory lace, pale gold scrollwork, a few small white daisies, tiny pale peach roses, muted sage leaves, fine flowing silk ribbons and two miniature butterflies. Make the decoration integrated and airy, with most detail in the upper-left and lower-left corners and within 25-50 pixels of the edges at 1280x720. No large flowers in the middle. Leave the whole central-left area empty and clean for information cards. Avoid placing decoration over any part of the woman. Keep the art elegant, light and uncluttered. No UI, text, numbers, logo or watermark.
This is an additive border edit, not a new portrait. Keep every part of the character and all original colors unchanged.

images.label: 02 侧望凝思·星月
images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image: the supplied image is the EDIT TARGET, not merely an inspiration reference.
Primary request: add tasteful decorative celestial edging and hanging elements to this exact existing wallpaper. Preserve the existing woman completely: same face, orange-gold hair color, hairstyle, expression, hand pose, clothing, gold sun ornaments, body proportions, scale and exact placement on the right. Do not redesign or redraw her. Preserve the light peach-ivory background tone and existing flower branch at bottom right. No global color grading or changes to brightness/saturation.
Add only: a thin refined pale-gold ornamental outer border, with curved star trails at the top and bottom corners, tiny gilded stars and small celestial ornaments. Introduce one small hanging crescent and a few tiny star pendants in the top-right/background space. A delicate sparse cream flower vine may intertwine the bottom-left and top-left border corners. These details should feel like elegant stationery decoration, harmonious with the existing gold hair ornaments. Decorations mainly occupy the outermost 20–35 pixels and the blank margins around the woman. Do not cover the face or hands. No large opaque additions and no dense texture.
Critical layout invariant: the broad left and central area, approximately x=60 to x=900 and y=55 to y=655 in the requested 1280x720 output, must remain clean and low contrast for overlaying account quota cards. No labels, no UI cards, no text, numbers, logos, watermarks or added people. Retain the original character and composition; change only the peripheral decoration.
Output: one bright landscape image, 1280x720. Delicate anime artwork, exact original subject preserved.

images.label: 03 抬手相伴·花藤
images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image: the original greeting character wallpaper, edit target.
Edit only the background decoration of this existing illustration. Preserve the woman's exact facial identity, facial proportions, expression, orange-gold hair color, hair shape, sunflower and black ribbon hair ornament, eye color, costume, skin tone, raised open-hand greeting pose, seated body pose, hands, lighting and exact placement on the right. Do not redraw or redesign the woman. Do not move, crop, resize, flip or recolor the woman. Keep the same 16:9 composition.
Add a delicate continuous ornamental frame around the outside edges: refined ivory lace filigree intertwined with thin pale gold botanical vines, small white daisies with amber centers and tiny pale peach flowers. The frame should mainly stay within the outer 20-35 pixels at 1280x720. Let a few petals float in the upper-right air behind her without covering her face or hand. Add two graceful soft ivory ribbon curls near the top-left and bottom-left corners, integrated into the floral border. Retain the existing flower decoration at lower right and complement it naturally. The result must feel like a polished fully designed anime illustration, with decorative flowers and elegant little elements rather than just a plain portrait.
Keep the large central-left 70 percent almost empty, warm-white and very low contrast for future information cards. No flowers, clutter or objects in that central reading area. Keep the original airy warm-white background and original natural colors; no added global filter, hue shift, contrast, dark vignette or desaturation. Preserve all existing subject details exactly. Do not introduce any words, numbers, lettering, logos, watermarks, UI panels or charts.
Output landscape 1280x720.
